title: Tommy Vercetti's last betrayal in GTA Vice City
subject: tommy
description:
Should Tommy have seen Lance's betrayal coming? 👇

The final night of GTA Vice City, when Sonny Forelli came to collect. Spoilers for the ending of GTA Vice City.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Lance Vance was standing beside Sonny Forelli when the shooting started.
Tommy now owned businesses all over Vice City, and Sonny had come down from Liberty City to collect his cut.
Lance, tired of living in Tommy's shadow, had quietly switched sides.
In Keep Your Friends Close, Tommy fought through his own estate, shot Lance on the roof, then killed Sonny inside the mansion.
No later game has shown what happened to him after that night in 1986.
Fans believe he still rules Vice City, the same city GTA 6 returns to on November 19.
